description: The first compatible release set of the standard's packages: record versions 1 and 2, the managed-custody profile, the verification report, the overlay contract at 0.6.0-draft, on the BSV stack baseline of @bsv/sdk 2.4.2 and @bsv/overlay 2.3.1 under Node 22. Candidate until the packages are published under the versions named here; a package published from this set carries the exact version named, and a later change to any wire contract or profile is a new set.

dependencies.name: mongodb
dependencies.note: the reference persistence of the index node, replaceable

dependencies.name: @bsv/wallet-toolbox-client
dependencies.note: the application service's wallet, not a dependency of any package here

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-core
packages.role: the record model (both versions), signatures, chain verification, the verification report, the native claim, the generic anchor, the managed acceptance record, publisher policy and evidence packages

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-overlay-topics
packages.role: the topic managers, lookup services, storage adapters, capabilities, history, export, retraction and synchronisation of the index, as a library; the node itself ships as the image

packages.name: @bsv/dpp-profiles
packages.role: the industry, exchange and operator profiles as frozen manifests with generated schemas and consumer documents, the lifecycle mapping for both record versions, and the GS1 identifier helpers

packages.name: @bsv/vsc
packages.role: the VSC draft compatibility profile with its owned context and schema artefacts and the two proof suites

alsoSupported: owner-signed transfer (spec/custody.md section 4) for version 1 lineages

serviceInterface.note: PassportService in the application repository is the account-agnostic entry point over the writer's journal; it consumes the packages above and is not itself published in this set.

artefacts.pins: the baseline this set claims, with every fixture digest
the report schema and reason codes

consumers.name: bsv-blockchain-demos/dpp-app
consumers.consumes: verbatim mirrors of packages/dpp-core, packages/overlay-topics and packages/dpp-profiles pinned by blob hash (packages/STANDARD_MIRROR.json), to be replaced by the published packages of this set
consumers.note: the example consumer with the sector workflows

consumers.name: bsv-blockchain-demos/uora-bsv
consumers.consumes: the four packages as vendored tarballs, to be replaced by the published packages of this set
